preregistration.note: Nulls are missing prerequisites; never replace original requirements to pass.

stages.action: Freeze original metric, quality band, populations, pricing basis and splits; baseline repeats plus cache and wiring receipts.
Inventory tested model-effort cells; walk from highest cost-plausible tier at low effort, include next-tier-up low comparator. Re-test near-floor pass/fail before pruning.
Freeze selected model/effort; validate shorter prompt against its unchanged prompt, retaining requirements. Re-probe one cheaper adjacent cell after prompt selection.
Measure original, model-only, prompt-only, and model-plus-prompt on the same cases; inspect interactions. Never infer combined savings from separate pilots.
If memory remains worthwhile, independently rebuild unchanged and changed memories three times from training data only; repeat inference within each build and charge build costs.

If routing remains worthwhile, evaluate the frozen router on the full weighted traffic frame against best single configuration; charge predictor, fallback and verification, including hard-tail errors.
Freeze one complete configuration and preregistration; run paired baseline/candidate joint confirmation once on sealed final test with at least three independent repeats; no tuning on its outputs.

limits: No raw cases, transcripts, usage, prices, baseline score, named band or variances supplied.
Pilot percentages have unspecified denominators; they are not bill-wide measured ceilings.
No new model/service behavior is measured by this program.
